nodes.value: Keep appendices derived from or linked to canonical machine contracts.
Version normative terms and references used across the construction program.
Write requirements as observable obligations with explicit scope and acceptance.
Preserve rationale, source, changes and conflict resolution lineage.
Every NFR must specify threshold, unit, workload, environment and measurement method.
Prevent aggregate success from masking a hard NFR violation.
Assign stable capability IDs and parent/child relationships.
Separate descriptive taxonomy from runtime availability/maturity.
Require downgrade/revalidation when assumptions or evidence become invalid.
Specify normal, degraded and failure behavior independently of implementation structure.
Tie behavior scenarios to executable acceptance tests.
Give each state machine one owner and stable version.
Reject illegal transitions, ambiguous terminals and unhandled recovery states.
Require explicit error/result and compatibility semantics.
Register every durable/wire schema under stable identity and owner.
Declare producer/consumer compatibility for every cross-boundary version change.
Require migration and rollback behavior before incompatible changes land.
Use stable envelopes with correlation, causation and deadline metadata.
Specify retry/idempotency and unknown-outcome handling per operation class.
Name authoritative state and consistency requirement for each domain.
Expose stale/unknown states rather than silently presenting inconsistent projections.
Choose atomic transaction, saga or reconciliation model per operation.
Persist compensation/recovery state before external effects where required.
Write outbox records atomically with authoritative state.
Deduplicate inbox handling before consumer side effects.
Never let cache contents become sole authoritative state.
Bind cache keys to tenant/version/trust context and define stale behavior.
Canonicalize bytes before digest where a format requires it.
Support digest migration without confusing logical identity.
Preserve source identity, acquisition time, rights/classification and parser version.
Quarantine malformed/untrusted inputs before downstream indexing.
Preserve page/region coordinates and extraction method for every derived claim.
Separate OCR/vision uncertainty from source text.
Record transformation identity, inputs, outputs and environment/version.
Propagate deletion, classification and trust constraints through derived data.
Define quality checks per dataset/use case and retain raw measurements.
Block promotion when critical quality failures violate declared thresholds.
Give every dataset/split immutable identity and provenance.
Track permitted use, retention, PII and benchmark contamination.
Label synthetic origin and generator configuration permanently.
Measure diversity, validity, bias and leakage against real/reference data.
Require registered inputs and explicit resource/budget admission.
Persist run state/checkpoints/evidence independently of worker lifetime.
Define data/model parallel topology and collective timeouts explicitly.
Handle worker loss/stragglers without corrupting optimizer/model state.
Checkpoint all state required for semantically equivalent resume.
Verify digest and compatibility before restore.
Record consumed data position and optimizer semantics across membership changes.
Use fencing/epoch identity to reject stale workers.
Capture enough telemetry to diagnose divergence without leaking restricted data.
Alert on non-finite values, stalls, throughput collapse and resource anomalies.
Evaluate candidates before registry promotion using fixed/versioned suites.
Require explicit disposition for regressions and uncertainty.
Separate experimental post-training from production model authority.
Record data, objective, algorithm and evaluation lineage for every candidate.
Keep environment side effects sandboxed and reproducible.
Version reward logic and detect exploitation/specification gaming.
Represent curriculum transitions and prerequisites explicitly.
Prevent easy-task cycling or metric gaming from starving required competencies.
Keep verifier authority separate from generator confidence.
Measure calibration, false accept/reject and shared-bias failure modes.
Preserve source bytes/digests, metadata classification and transformation lineage.
Apply resource limits and trust labels before decoding.
Preserve crop/region transforms so outputs can trace to source pixels.
Keep OCR text linked to page coordinates and confidence.
Detect conflicting OCR/text-layer evidence rather than silently choosing one.
Preserve sample rate/channel/time offsets across transformations.
Separate speech/music/event outputs with confidence and model identity.
Distinguish provisional transcripts from authoritative final segments.
Handle barge-in, reconnect, cancellation and timing backpressure explicitly.
Bound decode/frame sampling workloads before processing.
Preserve timestamps and source offsets across sampled frames/clips.
Normalize cross-modal evidence into comparable provenance-bearing results.
Apply tenant, time, classification and trust filters before ranking.
Require schemas, authority scope, side-effect class, idempotency and timeout metadata.
Separate tool implementation from authorization and admission decisions.
